notes: Upstream PrivateGPT quickstart suggests larger Ollama models; this hub keeps Qwen2.5-3B and nomic as required starters and offers optional 7B chat pins.
Do not auto-install ComfyUI-Manager, gallery warm-up, or unreviewed extensions.
At most one GPU service (localai, stable-diffusion, comfy-backend) may run on a single-GPU host.
Managed stack keeps FORKEDAI_BIND_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 and does not set LOCALAI_API_KEY until an explicit auth follow-up.
Video generation is out of scope for managed pins; see docs/use-cases-and-models.md.

Upscalers are not managed Hub pins: RealESRGAN and similar Hub releases are often .pth (treat as executable). Prefer reviewed safetensors placed manually under upscale_models/; do not add .pth pins to config/models.json.
